$comment: Stable design-system constants used by the workflows. Versioned in git so DS changes are auditable. The apply-ds-update workflow edits THIS file, then re-applies across mapped files. VERSION-BUMP DISCIPLINE: bump the top-level `version` on every DS change and commit it — that commit is the auditable record, and the bumped `version` is the target apply-ds-update stamps onto each updated flow (mappings.json `dsVersion`). apply-ds-update skips flows already stamped at the current `version` (resumable partial fan-out) and re-applies the rest. Colors are hex; scripts convert to Figma 0-1 RGB.

materialButton.note: reference only; CTA is built as a brand pill primitive

typography.rule: Swap family only; preserve iOS size, weight (mapped per-segment), line-height, letter-spacing.

layout.$layoutNote: Sections stack vertically, left-aligned (iOS on top). Both sections share firstScreenX + screenPitch so iOS/Android screen pairs column-align; re-space iOS (often ~415 pitch) to 460. Keep true device widths (iOS 375 / Android 412), left-aligned. Equalize section widths.

androidToIos.$comment: Constants for the REVERSE workflow (Android source -> iOS target), used by the android-to-ios skill. Grid constants (firstScreenX, screenPitch, screenBaselineY, sectionCornerRadius, sectionStackGap, padding, sidebarWidth) and tokens.brandPrimary are SHARED with the forward workflow above. iOS chrome component keys ship EMPTY: discover them via search_design_system against the iOS DS library on first run and commit them here (empty string = not yet discovered).

iosLibraries.$comment: Discovered: the iOS chrome comes from the published 'Core iOS 17 Components' library (no Tidepool-specific iOS lib or separate Apple HIG lib is published for this org).

iosStatusBar.note: 'iPhone X, 11 Pro / White' status bar (light, dark content), 375x40; also bundled inside iosModalNav

iosModalNav.note: 'iPhone X, 11 Pro / Modal Stack / Light / Base' (375x110): bundles status bar (375x40) + nav '.Left, Title, Right / Light' (375x42, key ae8ed46dfa95964f012b6f75c5ad95a650b70a29) + secondary-sheet card peek. Nav has NO component props; toggle child .visible + edit text directly. Default: Title + Left Accessory (chevron+'Left Title') visible, both Right Accessories hidden.

sheetGrabber.note: N/A for modal-stack presentation: the Modal Stack chrome conveys sheet presentation via the secondary-sheet card peek, not a grabber pill. Only add a drawn grabber primitive (~36x5 systemGray) for true page-sheet flows.

homeIndicator.note: Not a published component; drawn as a primitive: 375-wide x 34 frame, centered bar 134x5 r100 near-black (#000 ~ opacity 1).

typography.rule: Swap family only; pick SF Pro Text when fontSize < displaySizeThreshold else SF Pro Display; preserve Android size, weight (mapped per-segment), line-height, letter-spacing. NOTE: SF Pro's semibold style is spelled 'Semibold' (one word), not Roboto's 'SemiBold'.

layout.$note: Reuse the shared registry.layout grid keys (firstScreenX, screenPitch, screenBaselineY, sectionCornerRadius, sectionStackGap, sectionTop/BottomPadding, sidebarWidth). iOS device-vs-scroll threshold is iosDeviceHeight (812) vs the Android 892.

header.$comment: Loop iOS nav-affordance conventions consumed by the android-to-ios header rule (§4.3). The skill teaches the method generically and references these values; this is where the specific Loop choices live.
